gate.question: Do you want the serious version, or the not serious one?
gate.serious-hint: The clean portfolio. My background, my experience, my skills. The one you send with a job application.

hero.name: I am Théo
hero.role: Tech Lead & CTO as a Service
hero.intro: After several years as a Full Stack developer, I now wear the Tech Lead and CTO as a Service hat. I care about tech and about projects that actually matter, and I build them with a simple, effective method: ship fast, keep the code readable, and never add complexity without a reason.

about.text: Telecommunications engineer from INSA Lyon, with a year at Stockholm University on an Erasmus exchange. I started in electronics and embedded systems before moving to web and mobile. Today I am Tech Lead at Selego, between Amsterdam and Paris: I build, I recruit and train the teams, and I take startups from MVP all the way to scale. Among other things, I am lead developer of the API Engagement, built with beta.gouv.fr.
